description: Panneaux de signalisation Tsunami à Antibes Juan-les-Pins is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Antibes. List of 32 signs installed on the Commune to indicate to the population the evacuation routes to take shelter and safety depending on the location. Since the beginning of 2022, Civil Protection has implemented a tsunami scheme at the request of the Prefecture. Coverage: Ville d'Antibes. The portal shows the English title as "Tsunami signs in Antibes Juan-les-Pins" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Antibes. Its keywords include alerte, catastrophes-naturelles, inondation, mer, seisme, submersion. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. The listing shows 2022-09-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
